name: TB-500

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A synthetic peptide corresponding to the actin-binding domain of thymosin beta-4, distinct from full-length recombinant thymosin beta-4 studied in ophthalmology and wound trials. It has no FDA-approved product and is prohibited in sport under the WADA list. No FDA label exists. Prohibited in sport. Not the same molecule as full-length recombinant thymosin beta-4.

systems.note: Taken for soft-tissue and tendon repair via actin sequestration and cell migration; the intended effect.
Angiogenic activity is the basis of the claimed benefit and is also the basis of the concern; uncharacterised in humans at these doses.
No human safety data and no product-quality control.

monitors.why: No human safety record exists at these doses.
The accessible index of systemic inflammatory effect.
